details: The cryptocurrency market experienced a significant downturn, with Bitcoin plunging to multi-month lows around $65,385 before a slight recovery to $67,000. This drop was largely attributed to fresh US-Iran military strikes, triggering over $1.8 billion in crypto liquidations within 24 hours, the largest such event since the current cycle began. Ethereum also saw declines, and spot Ethereum ETFs recorded 16 consecutive days of net outflows, totaling over $90 million yesterday and $401 million in May. The Crypto Fear & Greed Index entered the "Fear" zone, reflecting bearish sentiment.
title: Crypto Market Dips on Geopolitical Tensions; Over $1.8 Billion Liquidated

details: Solana has registered an unprecedented eight consecutive red monthly candles, marking a historical low for the cryptocurrency. Despite this bearish price action, the Solana ecosystem continues to expand, notably through acquisitions like the $180 million deal for HoudiniSwap and the launch of native subscription features. Furthermore, the upcoming Alpenglow Consensus Upgrade in Q3 2026 is anticipated to drastically reduce block finality from approximately 12 seconds to 150 milliseconds, a development seen as bullish for attracting institutional DeFi and payment applications. Solana also faced over $83 million in liquidations during the recent broad market sell-off.
title: Solana Posts Record Monthly Losses Amid Market Downturn, Focus on Upgrades

details: The U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) has unveiled its strategic plan for 2026-2030, highlighting digital assets and distributed ledger technology as key priorities. The SEC aims to establish clear and predictable regulations for the crypto industry, fostering innovation while ensuring investor protection. Concurrently, the CLARITY Act, a significant bill for crypto market structure, has received strong backing from over 160 former national security, intelligence, military, and law enforcement officials. They argue that regulatory clarity is vital for the U.S. to maintain leadership in blockchain innovation and digital finance.
title: US SEC Prioritizes Digital Assets; CLARITY Act Gains Powerful Support

details: Zcash (ZEC) experienced a notable price increase of over 10% in the past 24 hours, reaching approximately $629. This surge followed the successful resolution of a critical Orchard bug. The fix involved an emergency soft fork where developers temporarily paused Orchard transactions, followed by the reinstatement of operations through the NU6.2 network upgrade.
title: Zcash (ZEC) Surges Over 10% After Critical Orchard Bug Fix
